estimates.assumptions: 3 large whole eggs (approx 150g total edible portion); standard value ~0.72g carbs/100g
2 small knobs of butter = 20g total (used for cooking and glazing); pure fat
1 tsp grated Parmesan cheese (approx 5g); standard value ~4g carbs/100g
3 fresh tarragon leaves chopped (negligible weight ~1g); standard value ~14g carbs/100g for fresh tarragon
1 tbs chopped fresh parsley (~6g); standard value ~6.3g carbs/100g with ~3.3g fiber/100g
1 tbs chopped fresh chives (~6g); standard value ~4.4g carbs/100g with ~2.5g fiber/100g
4 tbs grated Gruyère cheese (approx 60g); standard value ~2g carbs/100g
